displayDescription.en: Full-stack GaN power device team: epitaxy and substrate, HEMT design and gate process, reliability and failure analysis, packaging and driver integration, system design, and supply-chain localization.
displayDescription.zh: 氮化镓功率器件全栈团队：外延衬底、器件设计与栅极工艺、可靠性失效、封装驱动集成，到国产替代研判。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要做一款 650V 氮化镓快充开关方案，从导通电阻、开关损耗、栅极驱动到 PCB 布局帮我把设计参数和风险点算一遍。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I am designing a 650V GaN fast-charger switch stage. Walk me through the design parameters and risk points, from Rds(on) and switching loss to gate drive and PCB layout.

quickPrompts.en: I am designing a 650V GaN fast-charger switch stage. Walk me through the design parameters and risk points, from Rds(on) and switching loss to gate drive and PCB layout.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要做一款 650V 氮化镓快充开关方案，从导通电阻、开关损耗、栅极驱动到 PCB 布局帮我把设计参数和风险点算一遍。

quickPrompts.en: Our p-GaN gate 650V GaN devices show dynamic Rds(on) rising more than 30% after 800V bias — help me identify the root cause and design a verification plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们这批 p-GaN 栅极 650V 氮化镓器件在 800V 偏压后动态导通电阻上升超过 30%，帮我定位根因并给出验证方案。

quickPrompts.en: Map the GaN power device supply chain bottlenecks and localization progress, then judge supply-demand and competitive dynamics for 650V and 1200V segments over the next two years.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我梳理氮化镓功率器件的产业链卡点与国产替代进度，并判断未来两年 650V 与 1200V 段的供需和竞争格局。

profession.zh: 可靠性与失效分析专家
产业链与国产替代分析师
